name: Butterball 93/7 All Natural Lean Ground Turkey (Simmered Crumbles)
whyItWorks: Pre-ground poultry meat eliminates tough meat fibers, creating soft, easily chewed crumbles that digest rapidly. Low in saturated fat and high in bioavailable zinc and iron.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown in a skillet with a splash of olive oil and salt. Simmer with a little chicken broth to keep meat juicy and soft. Mix with white rice or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Choose 93/7 lean ground turkey rather than high-fat 85/15 varieties.
